instruction: A carpenter's hand saw built from chunky cubes, its stepped voxel blade lined with blocky triangular teeth and a pixelated wooden handle. A limited palette of grey steel and tan wood cubes gives it a crisp cross-stitched retro-game silhouette.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Hand Saw in a voxel/pixel style. A carpenter's hand saw built from chunky cubes, its stepped voxel blade lined with blocky triangular teeth and a pixelated wooden handle. A limited palette of grey steel and tan wood cubes gives it a crisp cross-stitched retro-game silhouette. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
